intent: One monochrome profile card: an accent ring draws around an initials avatar, the name, mono meta and bio rise from blur, three stats count up from zero, and Follow folds its plus into a check in the same box. The card lifts under a pointer spotlight.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (@container, CSS variables, color-mix)
stack.animation: motion/react (useInView, motion values, useMotionTemplate, useSpring, animate, AnimatePresence, SVG pathLength and d morphs)

layout.card: radius 22px, padding 24px (28px from @sm / @lg), overflow hidden for the spotlight layers
layout.vertical: centred stack: avatar 88px, name (20px gap), mono meta, bio max 34ch, stats panel, actions
layout.horizontal: one grid. Narrow: 64px | 1fr with avatar beside name, bio and full-width actions below. From @lg: 84px | 1fr | auto, avatar spans two rows, actions top right at their own width, bio under the name; stats along the foot under a hairline
layout.avatar: SVG ring (2px ink/8% track + 2.25px accent circle rotated -90deg) around a disc inset 9%
layout.stats: dl with N equal columns split by ink/8% hairlines; vertical inside an ink/3% panel with inset ink/6% and radius 14px
layout.actions: Follow 44px tall, radius 12px, beside a 44px square message button

typography.name: Instrument Serif 400, 34px (vertical) or 28-32px (horizontal), leading 1.02, tracking -0.015em
typography.meta: Geist Mono 11px uppercase, tracking 0.08em, ink/52, slash separators at 50% opacity; clock ink/38 tabular

color.accent: #ff8a4c via the accent prop, only on the avatar ring and the Following check (mixed 85% with ink)
color.follow: ink fill with on-ink text; following: ink/5% with an ink/14% hairline; unfollow hover: danger text and a danger/40% hairline
color.spotlight: 240px radial, ink 5% (dark) or 3.5% (light); edge copy at 28% / 22% masked to 1px

motion.entrance: once at 30% in view; blocks rise 6-16px from an 8px blur over 550ms: card 0, avatar 0.12, name 0.2, meta 0.26, bio 0.32, stats 0.4, actions 0.46 (s)
motion.countUp: from 0.52s, 70ms apart, 900ms, blur 5px -> 0, motion value text (no per-frame state); compact notation from 100,000 decided by the target
motion.followMorph: fill drains to a hairline in 200ms; two SVG strokes animate d (320ms, ease [0.65, 0, 0.35, 1]) plus -> check (accent) -> x on unfollow hover; labels cross-fade in one grid cell (in y 6px + 3px blur over 240ms, out y -6px in 140ms ease-in); invisible copies of every label fix the size
motion.unfollowGuard: Unfollow only appears after the pointer has left the button once
motion.followerTick: tracksFollow stat tweens +1 over 420ms, rising 6px from a 2.5px blur (falls from above on unfollow)
motion.hover: mouse only: lift -4px on spring 180/22, deeper shadow, pointer spotlight and edge light fade in on a spring
motion.ambient: the local clock refreshes every 30s; nothing else moves on its own
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades only; ring pre-drawn, figures set instantly, no lift, no blur, no icon morph

responsive.vertical: fluid to 380px; padding steps up at @sm
responsive.horizontal: actions drop under the bio and go full width below @lg; stat padding grows at @md
responsive.touch: 44px targets; spotlight and lift are mouse only, so touch never sees a stuck hover

accessibility: article labelled by the name heading
avatar aria-hidden; the name carries the identity
Follow is a toggle with aria-pressed and a constant aria-label; visible labels aria-hidden
polite status region announces follow and unfollow
counting figures aria-hidden with sr-only final values; clock prefixed 'Local time'
2px ink focus outlines offset 2px, keyboard only

content.name: Mara Okonkwo
content.bio: Draws letters for screens people read at 2am. Currently losing an argument with the lowercase g of a grotesque.

avoid: a cover image, gradient banner or verified badge
accent on the Follow fill, stats or text
a button that resizes between Follow and Following
an Unfollow flash right after following
a glow, tilt or bouncing entrance
per-frame React state for counting figures
blocks that pop in without the staggered blur rise
robustness: Secondary text uses at least 65% ink. Announce following only after the effective controlled or internal state changes. Reset the local clock when the time zone changes, including invalid zones.
